reason: A DSH Web interface plugin that presents live multi-session answer progress, model and tool execution traces, and configurable animated desktop-pet themes.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中以可配置的桌面宠物展示多会话回答进度、模型阶段、工具轨迹、token 指标和耗时。
summaries.en: A DSH Web interface plugin that uses configurable animated desktop pets to show multi-session answer progress, model stages, tool traces, token metrics, and elapsed time.

capabilities: Displays per-session response progress and estimated token metrics
Visualizes model stages and summarized tool-call traces
Provides configurable animated pet themes and draggable layout
Reads session events through polling and SSE and persists position locally
